name: Smith Machine Wide-Grip Bench Press
steps: Center a flat bench so the bar tracks over your chest and lie back with your feet planted.
Set your shoulder blades against the pad, take a wide overhand grip and release the hooks.
Lower the bar smoothly down toward your chest while keeping your forearms vertical under your hands.
Press the bar straight back up along the rails until your arms are extended.
tips: Keep your elbows tucked slightly below shoulder level rather than flaring them straight out to 90 degrees.
Avoid bouncing the bar off your chest at the bottom of the movement.
